title: Retention: pinning integration, expiration policy, GC semantics, audit log
description: Implement explicit retention for articles in IPFS. Every stored article must be either operator-pinned (covered by a pinning policy rule) or subject to GC. 'It is in IPFS' is not a retention strategy. This epic covers: pinning API integration, per-group expiration policy configuration, GC evaluation, GC execution, and an immutable audit log of all pin and unpin operations.
